_comment: Input to scripts/build-host-adapters.mjs for Microsoft 365 Copilot app packages. One app per agent. Tools are read-only names pinned in ai-plugin.json. Do not add factory_query, startup, or any write tool. The MCP URL and Teams app id stay placeholders in the generated manifests.

smith.short_description: Critical analyst. Stress-tests plans, claims and assumptions.

starters.title: Stress-test a plan
starters.text: Smith, stress-test this plan and rank the risks.

starters.title: Verify a claim
